name: assessments_level_comparison
description: Compare a person's capabilities with everyone on their role at their level, or one level either side: the person's live score on each capability and category beside the group's median score, both as percentages of the compared level (100 is meeting it). Group scores come from agreed ratings in a monthly snapshot (taken_on), and show only when the level has at least min_group_size people; levels lists each one's size, or nil when too small. scale says what the percentages mean at the compared level; a score with scored: false is nil, with its unscored_reason. Nothing names anyone in the group. Returns { enabled: false } when the tenant has comparisons off.
